UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 526 
Elidel (pimecrolimus) cream, tacrolimus ointment 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-502196  
Guideline Name 
Elidel (pimecrolimus) cream, tacrolimus ointment  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
2/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Brand Elidel, generic pimecrolimus, tacrolimus 0.1%, tacrolimus 0.03%  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The drug is being prescribed for a medically accepted indication that is recognized as a 
covered benefit by the applicable health plan’s program*  


--- PDF page 527 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 527 
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
• 
For Brand Elidel, generic pimecrolimus, or tacrolimus 0.03% ointment: Patient is at 
least 2 years of age  
• 
For tacrolimus 0.1% ointment: Patient is at least 16 years of age (for patients under 
age 16 yo, refer to off-label PA criteria)  
 
AND 
 
3 - ONE of the following:  
 
 3.1 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE topical corticosteroid in the past 
90 days  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 Drug is being prescribed for the facial or groin area  
Notes  
*Note: Medications used for anti-obesity/weight loss, cosmetic (e.g., al
opecia, actinic keratosis, vitiligo), erectile dysfunction, and sexual dysf
unction purposes are NOT medically accepted indications and are NO
T recognized as a covered benefit. Erectile dysfunction drugs (Cialis/T
adalafil) are covered for clinical diagnoses other than ED. 
 
Product Name:Brand Elidel, generic pimecrolimus, tacrolimus 0.1%, tacrolimus 0.03%  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The drug is being prescribed for a medically accepted indication that is recognized as a 
covered benefit by the applicable health plan’s program*

AND 
 
2 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy  
Notes  
*Note: Medications used for anti-obesity/weight loss, cosmetic (e.g., al
opecia, actinic keratosis, vitiligo), erectile dysfunction, and sexual dysf
unction purposes are NOT medically accepted indications and are NO
T recognized as a covered benefit. Erectile dysfunction drugs (Cialis/T
adalafil) are covered for clinical diagnoses other than ED.
